command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_03/nodes').value; foreach(`$n in `$nodes){`$u1='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_03/nodes/'+`$n.node_id+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$u0='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf/nodes/'+`$n.node_id+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$a=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u1; `$b=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u0; if(`$a.output -notlike 'Error:*' -and `$b.output -notlike 'Error:*'){`$la=`$a.output -split '\n' | Where-Object {`$_ -notmatch '^!Last configuration'}; `$lb=`$b.output -split '\n' | Where-Object {`$_ -notmatch '^!Last configuration'}; `$d=Compare-Object `$lb `$la; if(`$d){'### '+`$n.name; `$d | ForEach-Object {`$_.SideIndicator+' '+`$_.InputObject}}}}"
